laat_vaar.voor: doen elkeen 'n ander werk vir die operasie
laat_vaar.na: het elkeen 'n ander taak by die operasie
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'n Ander werk doen vir' reads wooden; 'n ander taak hê by' is the more natural way to say each discovery plays its own part.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'Elkeen doen 'n ander werk vir die operasie' is natural Afrikaans, and the swap from 'vir' to 'by' moves each discovery from serving the operation to being present at it, so this is a lateral move with a small meaning shift.

laat_vaar.voor: kan kieme by die wond kom
laat_vaar.na: kan kieme in die wond kom
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: Germs getting into a wound is more naturally 'in die wond kom'; 'by die wond kom' sounds like merely arriving next to it (preposition choice).
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'By die wond kom' is the idiomatic 'reach/get at the wound', which is exactly the point while the chest is open; 'in die wond kom' changes reaching to entering, so the preposition swap moves the meaning without fixing a fault.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: kan die nuwe hart in 'n liggaam klop wat aan infeksie sterf
laat_vaar_vorige.na: kan die nuwe hart klop terwyl die liggaam aan infeksie sterf
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: The relative clause hung on 'n liggaam' is clumsy for Grade 6; 'terwyl' keeps the meaning and reads more clearly.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: The extraposed relative clause is ordinary Afrikaans and the original image of the heart beating inside a dying body reads well; the proposal is a lateral move that drops 'in'.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: oor baie jare in verskillende lande
laat_vaar_vorige.na: oor baie jare heen in verskillende lande
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: The idiomatic Afrikaans for a span of time is 'oor baie jare heen'.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'Oor baie jare in verskillende lande ontdek' already reads naturally; adding 'heen' is a lateral move that only lengthens the sentence.

laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: The subject is 'baie mense', so a singular 'die wond' reads as one shared wound; each died of their own wound.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: The generic singular 'aan die wond gesterf' is natural Afrikaans for dying of the operation wound and matches the paragraph's later 'die wond'; the plural is only different.

laat_vaar_vorige.na: sonder dat iemand hoef te sny
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: With 'X-strale' as subject, 'sonder om te sny' says the X-rays do not cut; naming the implied person removes the dangling infinitive.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: A Grade 6 reader understands 'sonder om te sny' at once, and the proposal is longer and heavier without being clearly better.
